title: Park re-checks for a run, and slicer calls refuse an id that starts with a dash
lead: *Proposed.* `item.park` checks again for an unfinished run after `slicer park` and undoes the park with `slicer unpark` when a run started in between. Every slicer call that passes an item id as a positional argument refuses an id that starts with `-`, and the `item.*` handlers refuse it as `bad_params`.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 spec draft of S232 (S67 items 1 and 2) at f48a6154. `itemPark` checks for an unfinished run under `d.runs.mu`, releases it, then runs `slicer park` (`internal/daemon/items.go:80-85,93-110`). No slicer wrapper guards a positional item id that starts with `-` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:194-203,628-656`, `internal/slicercli/slicercli.go:96-103`, `internal/slicercli/write.go:56-64`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decisions (2026-11-17): adj 443 (Q8), the park race is closed by checking again after `slicer park` and undoing it with `slicer unpark`, not by holding the run lock across the write.

Correctness and safety. From S232, later notes of S67 (pair wave 3, 2026-11-01), re-checked at HEAD f48a6154:

- S67 item 1 (park race), still present. `refuseUnfinishedItem` takes `d.runs.mu` and releases it on return (`internal/daemon/items.go:141-142`); `itemPark` then calls `Slicer.Park` with no lock (`items.go:107-109`). Run admission takes the same lock (`internal/daemon/runs.go:1065-1069`) and does not look at the item's slicer status (no `parked` check in `internal/daemon` outside `wire.go:561`; `rg -n '"parked"' internal/daemon` finds none). A run admitted between the check and the write leaves a parked item with an unfinished run, which the refusal exists to prevent. The owner chose the re-check route (adj 443): holding `d.runs.mu` across `slicer park` would block every run read for the length of a slicer write, whose deadline is one minute (`internal/slicercli/write.go:21-23`).
- S67 item 2 (dash-leading ids), still present. `Note`, `Park`, `Unpark` and `Move` check only for a blank id (`internal/slicercli/write.go:209-218,649-682`); `Show` and `ShowRaw` check nothing (`internal/slicercli/slicercli.go:101-110`, `internal/slicercli/write.go:70-79`). The id goes into argv as a positional (`"park", id, "--render", "--json"`), so an id such as `--help` or `--root=/elsewhere` would be read by slicer as a flag. The daemon handlers check only `strings.TrimSpace(...) == ""` (`internal/daemon/items.go:25,47,90,160,180`). The repo already guards dash-leading values elsewhere (`internal/engine/land.go:48`, `internal/daemon/landed.go:72`, `internal/slicercli/write.go:341`).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestItemParkUndoesAParkRacedByARunStart` (`internal/daemon/items_test.go`): `runDaemon` with a slicer route for `park` and one for `unpark`; set the new hook `parkWriteHook` to `store.Create(runrec.Record{ID: "run-late", Project: "p", Item: "S12", State: "implement"})`. `item.park` `{"project":"p","item":"S12"}` returns code `refused` with message exactly `Cannot park S12: run run-late is unfinished`, and the slicer calls are, in order, `park S12 --render --json --root P` then `unpark S12 --render --json --root P`. Red first: today the park succeeds and no unpark runs.
- `TestItemParkReportsAFailedUndo`: the same, with the `unpark` route exiting 1. The error is code `internal` and its message starts `S12 is parked although run run-late is unfinished; slicer unpark failed: `. Red first: the park succeeds.
- `TestItemParkWithoutARaceWritesOnce`: no hook; the slicer calls are exactly one `park`. Passes on arrival; it pins that the re-check adds no write.
- `TestSlicerWrappersRefuseADashLeadingId` (`internal/slicercli/write_test.go`): for ids `-x`, `--help` and `--root=/tmp`, `Note`, `Park`, `Unpark`, `Move` (as id and as other), `Show` and `ShowRaw` each return an error whose text is `item must not start with "-"` (for `Move`'s other: `other must not start with "-"`), and `fake.CallsTo("slicer")` is empty. Red first: slicer is called.
- `TestItemHandlersRefuseADashLeadingId` (`internal/daemon/items_test.go`): `item.show` (`id`), `item.note`, `item.park`, `item.unpark` and `item.move` (`item` and `other`) with `-x` return code `bad_params` and call no slicer. Red first: the call reaches slicer (or the wrapper's internal error, once the wrapper guard exists).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and see them red for the stated reason.
2. `internal/slicercli`: add one helper, for example `checkID(name, id string) error`, that refuses a blank id (the current text) and an id that starts with `-` (`NAME must not start with "-"`). Use it in `Note`, `Park`, `Unpark`, `Move` (both ids), `Show` and `ShowRaw`. Keep the existing blank-id messages unchanged.
3. `internal/daemon/items.go`: in each `item.*` handler, return `badParams` for an id that starts with `-`, next to the blank check.
4. `itemPark`: add `var parkWriteHook func()` with a comment like `waveWriteHook`, called after `refuseUnfinishedItem` and before `Slicer.Park`. After a successful park, call `refuseUnfinishedItem` again; on a refusal, run `Slicer.Unpark`, then refresh Items and Deps and return the refusal. If the unpark fails, return the internal error described in the test. Do not hold `d.runs.mu` across a slicer call.
5. Docs: `docs/design.md` `item.park` row: an unfinished run found after the write undoes the park (*proposed*); the `item.*` rows: `bad_params` for an id that starts with `-`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`.

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): How should the orchestrator-only rg Check line say when it is done? -> orchestrator: keep that rg command and assign it to the orchestrator; done when it prints a match for the shared helper.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- A run started while 'item.park' is between its check and its write leaves the item unparked, and the call is refused naming the run.
- No slicer process is started for an item id or other id that starts with '-'; the daemon answers 'bad_params'.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/daemon ./internal/slicercli -run 'Park|Dash' -v` lists the new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- Assigned to the orchestrator: `rg -n 'must not start with "-"' internal/slicercli` is done when it prints a match for the shared helper.
